en.title: Setting up a company in Singapore or Indonesia
en.standfirst: Compare a Singapore holding company with an Indonesian PT PMA, including the capital rules to check before you budget.
en.metaDescription: Compare a Singapore holding company with an Indonesian PT PMA, covering foreign ownership, ACRA incorporation and PT PMA minimum capital rules for 2026.
en.body:
For founders deciding whether to **set up a company in Singapore or Indonesia**, the decision starts with the purpose of the business. Are you establishing a regional holding company, entering Indonesia's domestic market, or planning both?

A **Singapore holding company** and an Indonesian foreign investment company, known as a PT PMA, serve different roles. Understanding those roles, and checking **PT PMA minimum capital 2026** requirements before budgeting, helps connect your corporate structure with your plans for **ASEAN corporate expansion**.

## The hub and the giant

Singapore offers a route for establishing a regional holding company. Foreign ownership allowances, digital incorporation through the Accounting and Corporate Regulatory Authority (ACRA), and intellectual property protection are reasons businesses consider this structure.

Indonesia presents a different objective: establishing an operating presence within the Indonesian market. For the foreign-owned operating company structure covered here, the relevant entity is a PT PMA.

The practical distinction is between establishing a regional corporate hub and establishing a company for local operations. Your intended activities should guide the choice.

## Incorporating in Singapore

Singapore permits foreign ownership of local companies, while requiring at least one director who meets its local residency requirements. Incorporation takes place through ACRA's Bizfile system.

Singapore also has a low starting share capital requirement. ACRA states that a company requiring share capital needs at least **S$1 in share capital** to start. Its guidance distinguishes share capital committed by shareholders from paid-up capital actually received. [ACRA: Share capital and share types](https://www.acra.gov.sg/register/business/registering-different-business-structures/local-company/deciding-on-share-capital-share-types/)

The preparation process includes arranging the resident director appointment, engaging a corporate secretary and completing the relevant registration through Bizfile. Use [ACRA's official website](https://www.acra.gov.sg/) for incorporation instructions.

## Incorporating in Indonesia (PT PMA)

A PT PMA is Indonesia's foreign investment company structure. Before establishing one, identify the business activities the company will undertake and the corresponding Indonesian business classification, or **KBLI**.

Next, check the applicable investment rules. Indonesia's Positive Investment List provides the framework for identifying activities that are open to foreign investment and those subject to conditions. Ownership eligibility must be assessed for the particular activity. [BKPM: Indonesia's investment framework](https://www.investindonesia.go.id/)

Capital planning also needs careful attention. Confirm the current paid-up capital and investment value requirements for the proposed activities before committing funds. Registration and licensing proceed through Indonesia's OSS system.

The relevant agency is Indonesia's **Ministry of Investment / BKPM**, accessible through [Invest Indonesia](https://www.investindonesia.go.id/).

## The dual structure strategy

A business may use both jurisdictions: a Singapore holding company owning an interest in an Indonesian PT PMA that conducts local operations.

This combines the holding company role with an Indonesian operating presence. However, incorporating in Singapore does not itself give the business permission to conduct activities requiring Indonesian registration or licensing.

The decision therefore begins with the location and nature of the planned operations. A regional holding structure and an Indonesian operating company can complement each other, provided each entity meets the requirements applicable to its role.

zh.title: 在新加坡或印尼設立公司：如何選擇
zh.standfirst: 比較新加坡控股公司與印尼外資公司（PT PMA）的角色，以及編列預算前應確認的資本規定。
zh.metaDescription: 比較新加坡控股公司與印尼 PT PMA，涵蓋外資持股、ACRA 公司登記，以及 2026 年 PT PMA 最低資本規定。
zh.body:
對於正在考慮**在新加坡或印尼設立公司**的創業者而言，決策應從企業的目的出發。您是要設立區域控股公司、進入印尼國內市場，還是兩者兼顧？

**新加坡控股公司**與印尼的外資公司（稱為 PT PMA）扮演不同的角色。了解這些角色，並在編列預算前確認 **2026 年 PT PMA 最低資本**規定，有助於讓您的公司架構與**東協企業擴張**計畫相互配合。

## 樞紐與巨人

新加坡提供設立區域控股公司的途徑。外資持股的開放、透過 ACRA（新加坡會計與企業管制局）進行的數位化公司登記，以及智慧財產權保護，都是企業考慮這種架構的原因。

印尼則代表另一種目標：在印尼市場內建立營運據點。就本指南所涵蓋的外資營運公司架構而言，相關的實體是 PT PMA。

實務上的區別在於：設立區域企業樞紐，或是設立從事當地營運的公司。您預定從事的業務活動應引導這項選擇。

## 在新加坡設立公司

新加坡允許外資持有本地公司，但要求至少一名董事符合其本地居住要求。公司登記透過 ACRA 的 Bizfile 系統辦理。

新加坡的起始股本要求也很低。ACRA 說明，需要股本的公司只需至少 **S$1 的股本**即可成立。其指引區分了股東承諾的股本與實際收到的實收資本。[ACRA：股本與股份類別](https://www.acra.gov.sg/register/business/registering-different-business-structures/local-company/deciding-on-share-capital-share-types/)

準備工作包括安排居民董事的任命、委任公司秘書，以及透過 Bizfile 完成相關登記。公司登記說明請參閱 [ACRA 官方網站](https://www.acra.gov.sg/)。

## 在印尼設立公司（PT PMA）

PT PMA 是印尼的外資公司架構。設立之前，先確認公司將從事的業務活動，以及對應的印尼行業分類代碼 **KBLI**。

接著，查核適用的投資規定。印尼的正面投資清單（Positive Investment List）提供了判斷哪些活動開放外資、哪些附有條件的框架。持股資格必須針對特定活動進行評估。[BKPM：印尼投資框架](https://www.investindonesia.go.id/)

資本規劃同樣需要審慎處理。在投入資金之前，確認所擬活動目前適用的實收資本與投資額要求。登記與許可透過印尼的 OSS 系統辦理。

相關主管機關為印尼**投資部 / BKPM**，可透過 [Invest Indonesia](https://www.investindonesia.go.id/) 查詢。

## 雙層架構策略

企業可以同時運用兩個司法管轄區：由新加坡控股公司持有從事當地營運的印尼 PT PMA 的權益。

這結合了控股公司的角色與印尼的營運據點。然而，在新加坡設立公司本身並不會賦予企業從事需要印尼登記或許可之活動的權限。

因此，決策應從預定營運的地點與性質開始。區域控股架構與印尼營運公司可以相輔相成，前提是每個實體都符合其角色所適用的要求。
